description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It abstracts Android's native Log utility and supports chaining LogNodes for flexible log handling within Android apps.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging messages and chaining LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message to the current LogNode if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
